cb_step_1.title: Select the CT volume for processing
cb_step_1.instruction: Choose the CT volume to use.

cb_step_2.title: Create the Orbital_Region ROI
cb_step_2.instruction: In the Markups module, click ROI.

cb_step_3.title: Place the Orbital_Region ROI
cb_step_3.instruction: Click in a slice view to place one ROI around the orbital region, then adjust its handles to fit.

cb_step_4.title: Select the MarkupsROI node
cb_step_4.instruction: Select the ROI you created as the bounding box.

cb_step_5.title: Cut the volume with ROI
cb_step_5.instruction: Click the "Cut the volume with ROI" button.

cb_step_6.title: Create the Bone_Segmentation segmentation
cb_step_6.instruction: In the Segment Editor, create a new segmentation for OFR_CutVolume and name it Bone_Segmentation.

cb_step_7.title: Add the Bone_Segment segment
cb_step_7.instruction: In the Segment Editor, click Add, then rename the new segment to Bone_Segment.

cb_step_8.title: Open the Threshold effect
cb_step_8.instruction: In the Segment Editor, click Threshold.

cb_step_9.title: Set the threshold range
cb_step_9.instruction: Adjust the Threshold slider so the bone is highlighted.

cb_step_10.title: Apply the threshold
cb_step_10.instruction: In the Segment Editor, click Apply.

cb_step_13.title: Choose the fractured side
cb_step_13.instruction: Pick the colored box over the fractured orbit: Red for right, Blue for left.

operation_descriptions: Create an empty MarkupsROI node named Orbital_Region in the Markups module.
Create a new segmentation named Bone_Segmentation for the OFR_CutVolume volume in Segment Editor.
Add a segment in Segment Editor and rename it to Bone_Segment.
Activate the Threshold effect in Segment Editor.
Apply the threshold effect to create the bone segment.
Create an empty MarkupsROI node named Orbital_Region in the Markups module.
Manually click and adjust on the Slice views to create the ROI for the "Orbital_Region".
Manually click and adjust on the Slice views to create the ROI for the "Orbital_Region".
Cut the selected CT volume with the chosen ROI.
Create a new segmentation named Bone_Segmentation for the OFR_CutVolume volume in Segment Editor.
Add a segment in Segment Editor and rename it to Bone_Segment.
Activate the Threshold effect in Segment Editor.
Apply the threshold effect to create the bone segment.
Reconstruct the full bone model from the selected bone segmentation.
Segment the healthy and fractured orbit halves.
Reconstruct the fractured orbit using the symmetry plane.
